lines.text: Many learners say: I have gone to the market yesterday.
Better: I went to the market yesterday.
The second! I went to the market yesterday.

data.wrong: I have gone to the market yesterday.
data.right: I went to the market yesterday.

options: I have gone to the market yesterday.
I went to the market yesterday.

native.tip: في العربية نقول «ذهبتُ» أو «قد ذهبتُ»، لكن مع yesterday نقول went فقط: “I went to the market yesterday.”
native.caption: هل تقول أحيانًا هذه الجملة؟ “I have gone to the market yesterday.” 😅 في العربية نقول «ذهبتُ» أو «قد ذهبتُ»، أما في الإنجليزية فمع yesterday نقول went فقط، فالجملة الصحيحة “I went to the market yesterday.” استمع إلى Ama وكرّر! تدرّب أكثر في تطبيق Lexkite.
native.comment: الإجابة: “went” — مع yesterday نقول went. قلها بصوت عالٍ ثم اكتب جملة من عندك: {link}

en.tip: In Arabic we can say «ذهبتُ» or «قد ذهبتُ», but in English with yesterday we only say went: “I went to the market yesterday.” not “I have gone to the market yesterday.”
en.caption: Do you sometimes say this? “I have gone to the market yesterday.” 😅 In Arabic we can say «ذهبتُ» or «قد ذهبتُ», but in English with yesterday we only say went, so the right sentence is “I went to the market yesterday.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
